title: Laticlave

inlines.v: LAT'ICLAVE, noun [Latin laticlavium; latus, broad, and clavus, a stud.] An ornament of dress worn by Roman senators. It is supposed to have been a broad stripe of purple on the fore part of the tunic, set with knobs or studs.
